# Wrecked Metal v0.1.1 — Tester tools

A small update to make testing on more phones and tablets easier. The game itself is unchanged from v0.1.0-beta.

> **You need your own ROM.** This release contains no ROM and no game assets, exactly like v0.1.0-beta.

## What's new

- **Device info in the log.** `dd64.log` now starts with your device's model, chip, Android version, GPU and Vulkan driver, and every 30 seconds of play it records the average frame rate and the worst second. A report from your phone now says what ran it and how well.
- **Share log button.** On the start screen, tap **Share log** to send the last session's log straight to Discord, WhatsApp, e-mail or GitHub. No more digging through folders.
- **Device report template.** Opening an [issue](https://github.com/dedecidao/Wrecked-Metal/issues/new/choose) now offers a **Device report** form: model, chip, Android version, frame rate and the log. Reports from Snapdragon phones and tablets that can run 32-bit apps (Snapdragon 865 to 8 Gen 2, Android 10+) are especially welcome.

## Install

Download the APK below and install it over v0.1.0-beta: your settings, save and ROM are kept.

**Requirements:** Android 10+, Vulkan, and a device that can run 32-bit apps (this build is `armeabi-v7a`).

## Support

Wrecked Metal is free and will stay free. If you'd like to support the work, tips are welcome on [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/costelinha_games). Entirely voluntary, and nothing is locked behind them.

— Costelinha Games
